page.layout: One page of text in plainchant notation: red four-line staves with square notes and text lines between them. The left edge is cut off, so the start of each line is a fragment. No margins, running head or page number.

main_text.l: on ca ꝯ ꝯ ebo uestimentuoy
[illegible, ~3 letters] c. euouae. Vuiduca ē gꝯ [?]
ueata ungo mis ṅ a ex [?]

page.notes: The page is a manuscript leaf, not a printed one. The notation (neumes on red staff lines) cannot be transcribed as text and is not included. Red initials: a red ꝑ at the start of the first line and a red ꝯ/v before "Vuiduca". The left edge is damaged, so the first letters of each line are lost. Several words in the middle lines are doubtful; [?] marks the uncertain readings. The line "per quam salus mundi" is clear. Stains and show-through are ignored.
